# JPM — Catalysts

## TL;DR

The prior "Iran peace talks easing oil pressure" narrative from run 20260501_182928 has been directly falsified: UAE intercepted Iranian missiles on May 4 2026, WTI surged 4% above $106, Brent +5% above $114, and VIX spiked [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958]. Q1 2026 earnings (April 14) remain fully priced. No positive catalyst exists within the 10-trading-day swing window. Dominant recent headline is Dimon's own bond-crisis warning — bearish for credit-sensitive financials. Next scheduled binary: **Q2 2026 earnings July 14, 2026**, consensus EPS $5.39 [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].

## Upcoming events

- **Annual shareholder meeting: May 19, 2026.** (~11 trading days) Outside strict 10-day window. Dimon to present. Monitor for NII guidance language [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].
- **Kevin Warsh Senate confirmation: imminent.** FOMC held 3.50%–3.75% on April 29 (8-4 split — most dissents since Oct 1992). Powell exits as Chair May 15. Warsh succession introduces policy uncertainty; markets pricing no cuts in 2026 [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].
- **Dimon at Bernstein conference: May 27, 2026.** (~17 trading days) Outside window; watch for forward credit-cycle color [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].
- **Q2 2026 earnings: July 14, 2026.** Consensus Q2 EPS $5.39. Full-year 2026 tech spend guided to $20B. Next binary catalyst — 50+ trading days away [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].
- **NII guidance watch:** Trimmed from $104.5B to ~$103B in Q1 2026. Iran-driven oil spike increases inflation pressure, extending Fed hold — reduces NIM expansion probability. Next formal read at Q2 earnings July 14 [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].

## Recent news synthesis

- **Iran escalation May 4 (REGIME REVERSAL):** UAE intercepted Iranian missiles; WTI above $106, Brent above $114; Strait of Hormuz effective standstill. For banks: oil spike → inflation re-acceleration → extended Fed hold → NIM plateau + loan-loss provision risk. Directly falsifies May 1 Iran peace-talks catalyst [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].
- **Q1 2026 record earnings (Apr 14, fully priced):** Net income $16.5B +13% YoY, EPS $5.94 beat $5.49 est (+8.2%), assets $4.9T, equity $364B per 10-Q filed May 1 [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].
- **Dimon bond-crisis warning (dominant May 2026 headline):** CEO warning of "some kind of bond crisis" ahead — escalated from prior Apr credit-cycle warning. Bearish for credit-sensitive financials [swing_catalyst_news, run 20260504_182958].
- **Apple Card acquisition ($20B portfolio from Goldman Sachs):** Expands consumer lending footprint and adds tech-savvy accounts — structural positive, not a swing catalyst [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].
- **Exec harassment lawsuit retracted:** Bank internal probe found no supporting evidence — negative sentiment removed [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].
- **JPMorgan downgraded Meta Platforms:** Overweight → Neutral, PT $725 from $825 citing AI cost overhang — neutral to JPM itself [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260504_182958].
